outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs (time-lapse images), not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time; the individual measured data points (red squares for euchromatin, green circles for heterochromatin, including in the insets with error bars) are plotted directly alongside the fitted model curves, so individual data points are already displayed rather than only averages.
